harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Deployed a Python HTTP app on node2's private-network interface (10.50.50.11:8080, isolated to a dedicated firewalld zone bound to enp8s0). Configured VyOS on node1 as the WireGuard server (wg0 10.200.0.1/24, UDP 51820) terminating the tunnel, forwarding traffic from wg0 to the private eth1 network (10.50.50.0/24) shared only with node2, with default-drop input/forward firewall filters. Configured node3 (outside the private network) as a WireGuard client (wg0 10.200.0.2/24) routing 10.50.50.0/24 over the tunnel; added a return static route on node2 for 10.200.0.0/24 via node1. Falsified the tunnel dependency by stopping wg-quick on node3 and showing the app becomes unreachable (route falls back to the public LAN, no path to 10.50.50.0/24), then restored it and re-confirmed access. All three nodes were then restarted one at a time (VyOS `reboot`, RHEL `systemctl reboot`) using the acknowledge-then-disconnect pattern; boot_id changes were captured for each, and full recovery (WireGuard interfaces/peers, private IPs, static route, firewalld zone, app service, and end-to-end curl through the tunnel) was verified after each restart.
actions_performed: Surveyed topology: node1 (VyOS, eth0 public/eth1 private), node2 (RHEL10, enp1s0 public/enp8s0 private, unaddressed), node3 (RHEL10, single public NIC, outside private network)
Statically addressed the private link: node1 eth1=10.50.50.254/24 (VyOS set/commit/save), node2 enp8s0=10.50.50.11/24 via nmcli, verified ping
Generated WireGuard keypairs on node1 and node3 via wg genkey/pubkey
Configured VyOS wg0 (10.200.0.1/24, port 51820, literal private-key, peer node3 allowed-ips 10.200.0.2/32) and committed/saved

Configured VyOS firewall: input filter default-drop with established/related, SSH, and UDP/51820 allow rules; forward filter default-drop with established/related and wg0->eth1 allow rule; verified via config.boot
Confirmed net.ipv4.ip_forward and per-interface forwarding already enabled on node1

Installed wireguard-tools on node3, wrote /etc/wireguard/wg0.conf (address 10.200.0.2/24, peer=node1 endpoint 10.100.132.10:51820, AllowedIPs=10.200.0.0/24,10.50.50.0/24), enabled wg-quick@wg0, confirmed handshake
Added static route on node2 (10.200.0.0/24 via 10.50.50.254 dev enp8s0) for tunnel return traffic
Deployed systemd-managed python3 http.server on node2 bound to 10.50.50.11:8080
Created a dedicated firewalld zone 'private-app' bound to enp8s0 permitting only tcp/8080, isolating the app to the private network
Verified end-to-end app access from node3 through the tunnel via curl
Falsified tunnel necessity: stopped wg-quick@wg0 on node3, confirmed route falls back to public gateway and curl fails; restarted wg-quick@wg0 and reconfirmed success
Captured pre-restart boot_id and health baselines on all three nodes
Restarted node1 (VyOS reboot), polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id and full recovery (wg0, eth1, firewall rules, forwarding), re-verified tunnel handshake and app access from node3
Restarted node2 (systemctl reboot), polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id and full recovery (app8080, firewalld zone, enp8s0 address, static route), re-verified app access from node3
Restarted node3 (systemctl reboot), polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id and full recovery (wg-quick@wg0 active, handshake, route via wg0, curl success)

evidence.requirement: Private network topology discovery (node1/node2 private link, node3 excluded)
evidence.summary: Identified node1 eth1 and node2 enp8s0 as the private link, both unaddressed initially, while node3 has only a single public-network NIC

evidence.requirement: Private network addressed and reachable
evidence.summary: node1 eth1=10.50.50.254/24, node2 enp8s0=10.50.50.11/24, ping succeeds between them

evidence.requirement: WireGuard tunnel terminated on node1, keys generated on managed nodes
evidence.summary: Keys generated locally on node1/node3; VyOS wg0 configured and committed; node3 wg-quick client established with successful handshake

evidence.requirement: Firewall/forwarding on node1 permits only necessary traffic and routes tunnel to private LAN
evidence.summary: Committed default-drop input/forward filters with explicit allow rules for SSH, WireGuard UDP, established/related, and wg0->eth1 forwarding; ip_forward and per-interface forwarding confirmed enabled

evidence.requirement: Return routing for tunnel traffic on node2
evidence.summary: Added static route 10.200.0.0/24 via node1 private IP on node2; end-to-end ping from node3 to node2 private IP succeeded

evidence.requirement: App served on node2 TCP 8080, scoped to private network only
evidence.summary: systemd-managed python3 http.server bound to 10.50.50.11:8080; firewalld zone 'private-app' restricts port 8080 to enp8s0 only

evidence.requirement: node3 reaches the app only through the WireGuard tunnel (not directly)
evidence.summary: curl succeeds via wg0 route while tunnel is up; stopping wg-quick causes the kernel route to fall back to the public gateway and curl fails (falsifying test); restoring the tunnel restores access

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Pre-restart boot_id=4098161f...; reboot acknowledged and returned before disconnect; post-restart boot_id=6c805c84... (changed); eth1/wg0/firewall config and ip_forward all persisted; tunnel and app access re-verified from node3 after re-handshake

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Pre-restart boot_id=03408ac4...; systemctl reboot acknowledged before disconnect; post-restart boot_id=4ca3efb2... (changed); app8080/firewalld active, enp8s0 address and static route persisted, app reachable from node3 via tunnel afterward

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Pre-restart boot_id=6ab6a71b...; systemctl reboot acknowledged before disconnect; post-restart boot_id=8e9fd731... (changed); wg-quick@wg0 active with fresh handshake, tunnel route intact, curl to app succeeded
